provenance.kind: unchanged actual rejected plans with actual gateway metadata; scalar values cross-checked by exact valueHash from independently captured native baseline

time.value: The applied Dashboard reporting period (browser context shows Last 7 Days); returned startDate/endDate establish the actual normalized inclusive period for the performance panel.

grain.value: One current authorized Dashboard snapshot per panel: scalar panel values for the selected scope and date period, not entity identifiers or record counts.

caveats.value: Each Dashboard panel has its own population and time basis; values from different panels are not summed and a panel that is unavailable is reported as unavailable rather than zero.
The License Distribution total is the returned sum of independent status buckets that may overlap; it is not a certified count of distinct licenses.

The performance metrics cover the application-only performance pipeline; SLA compliance and approval rate are percentages with their own denominators and are not interchangeable with overdue task counts.

population.value: The current authenticated Dashboard workspace: My Tasks category counts, Service Application and Profile Verification summary cards, License Distribution status buckets, and the My/Team Performance metrics.

filterScope.value: The displayed Dashboard view is determined by the selected department/workspace and the applied time range; each panel keeps its own population and time basis.
